newsitem.title: LATVIA: TALLINNA SAYS NO TECHNICAL DEAL ON SAULES-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA SAYS NO TECHNICAL DEAL ON SAULES-REPORT.

text.p: Tallinna Pank has no technical agreement on a merger with Saules Bank and will make its plans concrete by the year-end, the Estonian bank's deputy chairman was quoted by newspaper Bizness I Baltiya as saying on Friday.
There has been some confusion over Tallinna Pank's plans for Saules, in which it already has a 20 percent stake.

Tallinna Pank yesterday said that it foresaw a possible merger with Saules as part of its short-term strategy. At a news conference, bank deputy chairman Targo Raus had said that the bank had agreement in principle.
But Saules Bank chairman Yuri Shchetinin has told Reuters that he had "no information" about such a merger.
"We have strategic plans of cooperation with Saules Bank and at the moment there are no technical preparations and agreements on this matter," Raus was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
"We plan to make our aims concrete before the end of 1997," he was quoted as saying.
Schetinin told the newspaper that he did not have any information that Tallinna Pank had fully discussed this issue. He said that Saules has not agreed to sell all its shares.
